facts: Magic Tea & Coffee, bubble tea, Town 'N' Country. This listing is 10069 W Hillsborough Ave, Tampa, FL 33615, phone (813) 290-0298. The site also lists Dunedin at 1507 Main St, Dunedin, FL 34698, phone (727) 315-4131, and Dale Mabry at 11642 N Dale Mabry Hwy, Tampa, FL 33618, phone (813) 373-5757. Website https://www.magicteacoffee.com/.

The site says drinks are made fresh to order: classic milk teas, fruit teas, ceremonial-grade matcha, cheese foam, smoothies, protein options, and coffee, with dairy-free choices available. DoorDash is offered for pickup and delivery. Gift certificates are mentioned.
Menu prices on the page include Magic House Milk Tea 5.95, Tiger Boba or Strawberry 6.95, Taro or Magic Ube 6.95, Thai or Matcha Thai 6.95, Pumpkin Spice Latte 7.25, and Pumpkin Spice Iced Tea 7.25.
No weekly hours were printed for the Town 'N' Country door. Stored hours only include Wednesday 11:30 to 20:00 and were not used.
